description.text: Teaching Objectives This program is designed to help students learn how business operations and decisions are shaped by a global market environment. It focuses on the use of analytical tools to help business leaders make better and more informed decisions by enhancing their understanding and analysis of the risks, challenges and opportunities faced by businesses in the international arena. The focus on the Chinese business environment, Chinese language and work internship opportunities in China are additional features of this comprehensive program. Core Courses Elementary Chinese Econometrics and Quantitative Methods Research Methods Microeconomic Theory Macroeconomic Theory Operation Research International Business International Marketing Mergers and Acquisitions Cross Culture Communicationand Management Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of International Business by Beijing Foreign Studies University

duration.text: The International Business at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6236 USD/per year ￥ 44900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Copy of photo page of passport 2. One recent passport photo 3. Custody Release Form 4. Proof of English Proficiency: TOEFL, IELTS or TOEIC 5. Transcripts/Mark Sheets 6. Diploma or Degree Certificate 7. Personal Statement 8. Letter(s) of recommendation (master program applicants) 9. Resume (master program applicants)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 2. Applicants must be under the age of 18. 3. Completed undergraduate degree in a relevant field from a recognized tertiary institution. 4. Proficiency in English language, must have TOEFL (IBT)88/ IELTS 6.5/TOEIC 800 scores or higher
